findings.evidence: `EpsilonEridani/Mathematics/TailIntegral.lean:25` ("Nothing in this file is physics-specific"), `:32` `namespace EpsilonEridani` — the repo's existing home for exactly this kind of lemma, same author.
findings.fix: Relocate them, public, to `EpsilonEridani/Mathematics/` under `namespace EpsilonEridani` (a measure/indicator file alongside `TailIntegral.lean`), and import from `Strip.lean`.
findings.issue: Five general lemmas whose statements mention only upstream types and whose proofs never touch `mellinDis`/`MellinDisConvergent` are exported from the QFT namespace: `aestronglyMeasurable_of_integrableOn_cpow_mul` (80), `aestronglyMeasurable_of_integrableOn_rpow_mul` (96), `locallyIntegrableOn_Ioi_indicator_Ioc` (210), `indicator_Ioc_eventuallyEq_zero_atTop` (226), `indicator_Ioc_eventuallyEq_nhdsGT` (232). Their root-namespace-style names promise general infrastructure that is only reachable as `EpsilonEridani.QFT.Factorization.Convolution.indicator_Ioc_eventuallyEq_nhdsGT`, inviting re-derivation elsewhere.

findings.fix: Delete it and inline `continuousOn_id.rpow_const fun _ hx => Or.inl hx.1.ne'` at the two use sites.
findings.issue: `continuousOn_rpow_const_Ioc` is a one-line specialization of Mathlib's `ContinuousOn.rpow_const` to `Ioc 0 1` (its own proof is that application), used only at lines 133 and 155; exporting it adds a duplicate of upstream API under the QFT namespace.

findings.fix: Add `ordConnected_setOf_mellinDisConvergent (f) : {σ : ℝ | MellinDisConvergent f σ}.OrdConnected := (isUpperSet_setOf_mellinDisConvergent f).ordConnected`, and the betweenness restatement the roadmap phrases.
findings.issue: The §0.1 named product — "the domain of convergence is an interval" — is not exposed: only `isUpperSet_setOf_mellinDisConvergent` is stated, while the module docstring (line 38) and the Main results list claim "in particular an interval". Consumers get no `OrdConnected` statement and no betweenness form (`σ₀ ≤ σ ≤ σ₁` with convergence at both ends).

findings.evidence: Proof reduces to integrability of `x ^ (N.re - 1 + c)` on `(0,1]`, i.e. `-1 < N.re - 1 + c` ⇔ `-c < N.re`; `intervalIntegral.integrableOn_Ioo_rpow_iff` does not require the exponent to be a negation.
findings.fix: State it for a general real exponent: `@[simp] theorem mellinDisConvergent_rpow_iff {c : ℝ} : MellinDisConvergent (fun x => x ^ c) N ↔ -c < N.re` (same proof; the `-b` reading is then `simp`-reachable).
findings.issue: `mellinDisConvergent_rpow_neg_iff` is needlessly restricted to the exponent shape `-b`, and as a `@[simp]` lemma its LHS `fun x => x ^ (-b)` only unifies with a syntactic `Neg.neg`, so it never fires on `x ^ c` for a numeral or positive exponent (e.g. the `x ^ β` endpoint case §0.1 still needs).

findings.evidence: Mellin.lean:94-98 adds `mellinDisConvergent_def`; grep for `mellinDis_def` across `EpsilonEridani/` returns no hit, while Strip.lean:176-177 unfolds the definition.
findings.fix: Add `mellinDis_def : mellinDis f N = ∫ x in Set.Ioc (0:ℝ) 1, (x : ℂ) ^ (N - 1) * (f x : ℂ) := (rfl)` next to `mellinDisConvergent_def` and rewrite with it in `Strip.lean`.
findings.issue: `mellinDis` has no `_def` restatement even though the PR adds `mellinDisConvergent_def` for the neighbouring definition, so the new file unfolds the body directly (`rw [... , mellinDis]` at Strip.lean:177).

summary: Six physics-free general lemmas are exported from the `EpsilonEridani.QFT.Factorization.Convolution` namespace instead of the repo's canonical home for such material, the §0.1 "domain of convergence is an interval" product is advertised in the docstring but not stated, and the `@[simp]` sharpness lemma is specialized to `x ^ (-b)` so it cannot fire on a general rpow exponent.
